title: Agents and MCP
heading: Stellar Assist
text: Lists your groups, reads balances and records expenses from a chat message. Proposes a settlement: who to pay and how much, without paying. When its operator gives it a signer, pays within the server caps from its own Testnet account, on your behalf once you link it.

title: Agents and MCP
heading: The MCP server
text: Code in mcp/ . Node 22 or newer, ES modules, dependencies @modelcontextprotocol/sdk , @stellar/stellar-sdk and zod . Tool names keep the project's earlier name, ledgerly_* .

heading: Approval flow Planned
text: The design: above the ask-me-first threshold the API holds the payment as a pending approval, you approve or reject it in the app, and it expires after an hour. An agent can never approve its own request, because approving needs a person's session and agent tokens get 403 on person-only routes. None

title: Agents and MCP

title: Authentication
heading: Agent tokens

The API stores only its SHA-256, mapped to the agent's Stellar address, in the AGENT_TOKENS environment variable ( sha256hex=GADDRESS pairs, comma separated). title: Authentication
heading: Headers
text: Header Use Authorization: Bearer <token> Every route except GET /v1/health , POST /v1/auth/challenge and POST /v1/auth/verify Content-Type: application/json POST and PATCH bodies. Bodies must be a JSON object Idempotency-Key Optional on POST /v1/groups/:id/expenses . 8 to 64 letters, digits, - or _

title: Authentication
heading: Keep secrets off the client
text: Never send a secret key Any request body that contains something shaped like a Stellar secret key ( S plus 55 base32 characters) is refused with 400 SECRET_KEY_REJECTED , before parsing and again after, so JSON escapes do not get past it. Sign in the wallet, send only signatures and public addresses

title: Concepts
heading: Concepts
text: The objects the API works with and the rules it enforces. Amounts are always decimal strings, never JSON numbers.

title: Concepts
heading: Groups
text: A group has a name (up to 80 characters), a type ( flat , trip or other ) and one settlement asset, USDC by default. The creator joins as the first member. Only members can see or change a group: a non-member gets 404 , so group ids cannot be probed.

title: Concepts
heading: Members
text: A member is a Stellar address in a group, with kind human or agent , a display name (defaults to the short address) and a home currency. A group holds at most 50 members. You add members directly by address or with an invite link.

title: Concepts
heading: Expenses
text: An expense has a description (up to 200 characters), an amount , the member who paid ( paidBy ) and a split . Its source is manual , scan or agent ; an expense created with an agent token is always agent .

title: Concepts
heading: Splits: equal and exact
text: { "type": "equal", "participants": [ "a3e1b7c2-0d4f-4e5a-8b9c-1d2e3f4a5b6c", "c9d8e7f6-5a4b-4c3d-9e2f-1a0b9c8d7e6f" ] } { "type": "exact", "shares": [ { "memberId": "a3e1b7c2-0d4f-4e5a-8b9c-1d2e3f4a5b6c", "amount": "30.00" }, { "memberId": "c9d8e7f6-5a4b-4c3d-9e2f-1a0b9c8d7e6f", "amount": "12.00" }

title: Concepts
heading: Balances
text: Each member has a net . Positive means the member is owed money, negative means the member owes. A group's nets sum to zero. GET /v1/groups/:id also returns myPosition with suggested transfers ( owes and owed ), computed by the shared suggestTransfers rule.

title: Concepts
heading: Settlement intents
text: Paying is two steps, so a payment is always tied to one reserved debt: Reserve. POST /v1/groups/:id/settlements/intents with { to, amount } returns an intent with payTo , a memo and expiresAt (10 minutes). Pay. Build a USDC payment to payTo for exactly amount , with the memo as MEMO_HASH and time bo

title: Concepts
heading: Memos
text: The intent memo is a hash memo: sha256("stellar-split:intent:" + intentId) in hex. It ties the on-chain payment to one intent, so an older payment cannot settle a new debt.

title: Concepts
heading: Horizon verification
text: A settlement is recorded only when Horizon on Stellar Testnet shows a successful transaction that: pays the group's asset from the payer's address to the creditor's address, for exactly the intent amount, carries the intent memo as MEMO_HASH , has time bounds that end no later than the intent expiry

title: Concepts
heading: Spend policy
text: The server caps agents, not people. An agent cannot reserve an intent (or get dry-run terms) that would take it over 25 per payment , 50 in 24 hours or 200 in 30 days , counted over all its groups. The answer is 403 AGENT_CAP_PER_PAYMENT , AGENT_CAP_PER_DAY or AGENT_CAP_PER_MONTH with details: { lim

title: Errors and limits
heading: Settlement verification codes
text: When you record a settlement, the API checks the transaction on Horizon. A failed check answers 422 with one of these codes (on the x402 route, a fresh 402 with the code in error ). Code Meaning PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND Transaction not found on Stellar Testnet. Wait for it to land, then retry PAYMENT_FAILE

title: Errors and limits
heading: Rate limits
text: The only rate limit in the code is on the receipt scan: 10 scans per person per 10 minutes , counted per serverless instance. Over it, 429 RATE_LIMITED . The API sends no rate-limit headers and no Retry-After . JavaScript Python async function withRetry(fn, tries = 4) { for (let i = 0; i < tries; i+

title: Errors and limits
heading: Body limits
text: 64 KB for every body, except the receipt scan (1.4 million base64 characters of photo). Over the limit: 413 with a JSON error, and the connection closes. Bodies must be JSON objects. Arrays, null or invalid JSON: 400 VALIDATION .

title: Errors and limits
heading: Idempotency
text: POST /v1/groups/:id/expenses accepts an Idempotency-Key header (8 to 64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 - _ ). A repeat with the same key in the same group returns the first expense and creates nothing. Use one key per form submission. Settlements are idempotent by transaction hash: a hash is recorded once, a repeat

title: Errors and limits
heading: What is safe to retry
text: 502 UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE : yes, with backoff. 422 PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND right after submitting: yes, after a few seconds. POST .../expenses : yes, with the same Idempotency-Key . A signed payment: never sign a second payment for the same intent. Record the first hash.

title: Errors and limits
heading: Versioning
text: All routes are under /v1 . There is no other version today. Fields may be added to responses, so ignore fields you do not know.

title: Integrations
heading: Integrations
text: There are no API keys for third parties. Your integration acts as a signed-in person (wallet session) or, if the operator registers it, as an agent with its own token.

title: Integrations
heading: Call the API from a backend
text: Run the sign-in flow once with the account your service acts as, keep the 12-hour session token on the server, and sign in again when it expires. Use a Testnet account that holds only test funds. JavaScript Python // Node 22+, server side only const API = 'https://stellar-split-sooty.vercel.app/v1';

title: Integrations
heading: Invite links and deep links
text: POST /v1/groups/:id/invites returns an inviteUrl of the form: https://stellar-split-sooty.vercel.app/invite/<code> The web app also serves /join/<code> for the same code. Opening either link asks the person to connect Freighter and sign in, then calls POST /v1/invites/:code/accept . An invite create

title: Integrations
heading: Verify a settlement on chain
text: Each settlement carries txHash . Activity items also carry an explorerUrl . You can check a payment yourself without trusting the API: curl JavaScript Python # The transaction: memo_type must be "hash" and memo the intent memo (base64 on Horizon) curl -sS https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org/transact

title: Integrations
heading: CORS
text: The API answers CORS only for origins in its ALLOWED_ORIGINS setting (by default the app's own APP_URL ). In production the web app and the API share one origin, so a browser app on another origin gets no CORS headers and its requests are blocked. Call the API from your backend instead. Header Value

title: Integrations
heading: Webhooks Planned
text: The API sends no webhooks. To react to new activity, poll GET /v1/groups/:id/activity at a modest interval.

title: Integrations
heading: OpenAPI and SDKs Planned
text: There is no published OpenAPI file and no SDK package. Use plain HTTP as shown in these docs.

title: Security model
heading: Protections in the API
text: SEP-53 sign-in with single-use, HMAC-signed challenges. Sessions are HMAC-signed and expire after 12 hours. Agent tokens are stored only as SHA-256 hashes and compared in constant time. title: Security model
heading: Your integration
text: Never send, log or store a Stellar secret key. Sign in the wallet or on a host you control. Keep session tokens, agent tokens and MCP_AUTH_TOKEN server side. Verify a payment on Horizon yourself when it matters to you. See Integrations .
